## Checklist

- [ ] The plugin targets JByteMod Remastered 2.11.0 or newer.
- [ ] The `id` matches the fully qualified concrete `Plugin` class.
- [ ] The release URL points to an immutable JAR asset.
- [ ] The SHA-256 value was generated from that exact asset.
- [ ] The version, file name, and download URL agree.
- [ ] The JSON follows `schema.json` and contains no duplicate plugin ID.
